start_ddp_workers: start multiple DDP worker processes across all available GPUs using Hydra config
create_children_manager: create a ChildrenManager context manager to spawn and monitor subprocess worker processes
add_child_process: add a subprocess to the ChildrenManager and assign it a rank for tracking
review_children_manager_exit: review the ChildrenManager exit logic that waits for workers and terminates on failure or interrupt
refactor_start_ddp_workers: refactor start_ddp_workers to customize the world size or worker spawn arguments
